policy.meaning: Topic-specific pre-decision narrative relevance; all nine reference cases still meet the same hard comparability constraints. No suitability denominator is changed.
policy.metric: Precision@3 and mean reciprocal rank; prototype validation on simulated cases
policy.baseline: Same hard filters, rank by fewest noncritical structured differences, stable episode ID for exact ties; narrative text unused
policy.holdout: Query families have no reference episodes; no supervised training or parameter tuning on these judgements

fixtures.text: People would like to learn culinary techniques and prepare meals together in this venue.
Participants ask for hands-on tuition in making dishes, working with ingredients and preparing dinner.
Local performers need ensemble sessions, melodic instruction and a place to practise songs.
People hope to learn to play instruments together and rehearse tunes with a vocal group.
Participants seek low-impact workouts, mobility sessions and opportunities to improve physical wellbeing.
The venue could offer guided body conditioning, flexibility sessions and active healthy movement.
